outcome: neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rates
cohort: 150 pregnant women with OC and 300 healthy pregnancies
finding: Obstetric cholestasis is associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preterm birth, low birth weight, neonatal respiratory distress syndrome, and increased NICU admission rates, cesarean section rates, and postpartum hemorrhage.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at OC diagnosis was 28 weeks
